name: hy3-study-clinic
description: Evidence-grounded quiz, grading, and mistake-remediation study app powered by Hy3 (with a deterministic offline fake provider).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hy3-clinic/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @hy3-clinic/server" "npm run dev -w @hy3-clinic/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @hy3-clinic/shared && npm run dev -w @hy3-clinic/server
